notes: Cash-basis county; all funds governmental, business_type null. Receipts/disbursements from the Total Government Funds column of the governmental funds statement (p4-5). Property/Motor Vehicle Taxes 23,462,375 split per the Statement of Activities general receipts (p2: Property 21,268,645 + Motor Vehicle 2,193,730). State 7,405,397 split into the printed fund-schedule State lines: General Fund (p6) 2,279,644, Jail Bond (p8) 203,615, Road Fund (p9) 3,509,656, Total Nonmajor column (p12) 1,412,482; all tie to the statement's fund columns. Federal 9,923,562 and Other 14,580,703 kept as single lines (Other is mixed: commissions, fees of office, inheritance tax 2,881,152, Insurance Fund receipts 4,937,847, lottery 907,405, commissary...). Cash and fund balance are separate: the statement rolls forward fund balances (beginning 34,874,292, ending 40,735,270); no beginning cash is printed, so cash fields are null (as later years); ending cash is printed only as two lines (cash 24,066,945 and restricted cash 14,751,998) on p3; ending_investments = certificates of deposit 2,697,517. Balance sheet = governmental funds cash-basis statement p3 (Statement of Net Position p1 totals equal it; its cash lines differ by $1 rounding: 24,066,946 / 14,751,997). Detail: General Fund receipts from the budget schedule (p6) and transfers in (p7); General Fund spending from the department-by-object schedule (p13; total 31,524,790 incl. transfers 1,032,277), which supersedes the p6-7 department lines (budgets there are by department, so budget_final null on object lines except single-line departments). Major funds from pp8-10; nonmajor funds one line per fund column (pp11-12), zero cells omitted; Insurance Reserve had only a transfer out, Drug Seizure no activity. Nonmajor spending functions taken from the statement's Other Governmental Funds column (p4), which ties exactly by fund; Noxious Weed spending is natural resources/conservation per user rule. ARPA 'Other Receipts' 5,958,551 recorded as federal grants because the statement prints the same amount on its Federal row. Zero-actual budget lines omitted except Road Fund state Grants (budget 21,070). p14 (tax certified analysis) has no cash-flow data. Read pages 1-14 of 14
